components.name: Booking Button

components.html: Agendar horário
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 0.875rem; background-color: #c37c33; color: #140f0c; font-family: var(--font-outfit), sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -6px rgba(195,124,51,0.4); transition: all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary svg { transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background-color: #cd853d; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -4px rgba(195,124,51,0.55); } .ds-btn-primary:hover svg { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary-beam { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 45%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.22), transparent); animation: ds-light-sweep 4s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; } @keyframes ds-light-sweep { 0% { transform: translateX(-150%) skewX(-20deg); } 25%, 100% { transform: translateX(250%) skewX(-20deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary-beam { display: none; } }

components.css: .ds-card-channel { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid rgba(195,124,51,0.2); border-radius: 0.875rem; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #221b16 0%, #1a1410 100%); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-plus-jakarta-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card-channel-main { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.875rem; } .ds-card-channel-tile { display: flex; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid rgba(195,124,51,0.3); border-radius: 0.625rem; background-color: rgba(195,124,51,0.15); color: #c37c33; transition: transform 0.3s; } .ds-card-channel-title { display: block; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-card-channel-detail { display: block; color: #c37c33; } .ds-card-channel-chevron { display: flex; color: #9c8e82; transition: transform 0.3s ease-out, color 0.3s; } .ds-card-channel:hover, .ds-card-channel:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(195,124,51,0.55); background: linear-gradient(145deg, #2a221c 0%, #221b16 100%); transform: translateY(-1.5px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-card-channel:hover .ds-card-channel-tile { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-card-channel:hover .ds-card-channel-title { color: #ffdcc0; } .ds-card-channel:hover .ds-card-channel-chevron { transform: translateX(0.375rem); color: #c37c33; } .ds-card-channel:active { transform: scale(0.985); }

components.css: .ds-portrait { position: relative; width: 8rem; height: 8rem; margin: 0.75rem; } .ds-portrait-halo { position: absolute; inset: -0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #c37c33, rgba(161,94,31,0.35), transparent); filter: blur(16px); animation: ds-halo-pulse 4.5s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-portrait-ring { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #c37c33, #784312, #382e26); box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transition: transform 0.5s; } .ds-portrait:hover .ds-portrait-ring { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-portrait img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; object-fit: cover; } @keyframes ds-halo-pulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.65; } 50% { transform: scale(1.15); opacity: 0.95; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-portrait-halo { animation: none; opacity: 0.7; } }

narrative.overview:
The room is dark coffee brown and almost featureless. One warm light hangs over the chair, and whatever sits under it is what matters: Lucas's portrait at the top of the page, and the button that books him. Everything else is furniture in the half-dark, legible and reachable but never competing for the light. This is the visual form of the product's position: the client chooses a person, so the person is the only thing lit.

The system is a single narrow column built for a phone held in one hand. Density is high and type is compact, so hierarchy comes from light and color before it comes from size. Surfaces are warm near-blacks separated by tone and a hairline border. Cognac is the only hue. Components are warm and inviting: soft corners, a slow glow, and gentle continuous motion that draws the thumb toward the booking action.
keyCharacteristics: One hue (cognac) on a ramp of coffee-brown neutrals; cream for text.
A radial cognac glow anchored at the top of the page, behind the portrait.
A single column capped at 28rem, centered, with generous side gutters.
Compact type in three sizes; uppercase tracked labels in place of section headings.
Ambient motion on exactly two things: the portrait halo and the booking button.
On load the lamp blooms once while content settles in quickly beneath it.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Cognac is the only hue in the system. No second accent, no status colors on the page. If something needs emphasis, it gets more cognac or more light, not a new color.

rules.name: The Solid Fill Rule
rules.body: Solid cognac fill belongs to the booking button alone. Everywhere else cognac appears as a stroke, an icon, a tint, or a gradient stop.

rules.name: The Three Sizes Rule
rules.body: The page has three type sizes, each with one job: 1.875rem for the name, 0.875rem for anything read or tapped, 0.75rem for uppercase labels and chips. Nothing a visitor has to read as a sentence is set below 0.875rem.

rules.name: The Outfit-Is-Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Outfit only ever appears uppercase. Sentence-case text is always Plus Jakarta Sans.

rules.name: The Two Glows Rule
rules.body: Cognac glow belongs to the portrait and the booking button. Nothing else on the page emits light.

rules.name: The Shadow-On-Touch Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat at rest. Dark shadow is a state, never a resting decoration.

dos: Do keep cognac (#c37c33) as the only hue, and reserve its solid fill for the booking button.
Do separate surfaces with tone and a 1px border; cards use cognac at 20%, quiet controls use Coffee 700.
Do use 0.875rem corners on controls and cards, 0.625rem on tiles nested inside them, and full rounding on chips and the portrait.
Do build hierarchy below the name from weight, case, tracking, and color, at 0.875rem for reading and 0.75rem for uppercase labels.
Do give every interactive element a hover and a press response: a warmer fill or border, and a small scale-down on press.
Do show keyboard focus as a 2px solid cognac outline offset 2px, on every focusable element.
Do theme the surfaces the browser draws: toasts use the popover tokens in dark theme, the page declares `color-scheme: dark` and a Coffee 950 `theme-color`, and selection is cognac at 30%.
Do stagger new sections into the existing reveal sequence, keep the last delay at or under 0.3s, and honor `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Do reference the named tokens: palette colors, `--shadow-glow`, `--shadow-glow-strong`, `--shadow-lift`, and `--ease-out-expo`. The palette in `globals.css` is the only place a hex value is written; derive tints with `--alpha()` and in-between tones with `color-mix()`.
donts: Don't add a second accent color or status hues to the page.
Don't set white or cream text on solid cognac; text on the booking button is Coffee 950.
Don't give resting cards a drop shadow; shadow is a hover and focus state.
Don't put a cognac glow on anything other than the portrait and the booking button.
Don't add ambient looping motion to a third element; the halo and the booking beam are the only two.
Don't set Outfit in sentence case or use it for running text.
Don't introduce breakpoints that split the column; the page is one column at every width.
Don't space every block evenly; keep 0.625rem inside a group and 1.75rem to 2rem between groups.
Don't hide content behind its entrance: no `opacity: 0` base state, and nothing may delay the booking button past 0.2s.
